article.headline: Oklahoma City takes home win streak into matchup with Atlanta
article.description: Atlanta Hawks (8-6, fifth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Oklahoma City Thunder (9-5, seventh in the Western Conference)
article.title: Oklahoma City takes home win streak into matchup with Atlanta
article.linkText: Oklahoma City takes home win streak into matchup with Atlanta
article.story: Atlanta Hawks (8-6, fifth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Oklahoma City Thunder (9-5, seventh in the Western Conference) Oklahoma City; Wednesday, 8 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Oklahoma City will try to keep its five-game home win streak alive when the Thunder play Atlanta. The Thunder have gone 5-0 at home. Oklahoma City is fourth in the Western Conference with 34.6 defensive rebounds per game led by Isaiah Hartenstein averaging 7.7. The Hawks are 5-3 in road games. Atlanta ranks fifth in the Eastern Conference with 44.9 rebounds per game led by Jalen Johnson averaging 9.0. The Thunder average 10.9 made 3-pointers per game this season, 1.7 fewer makes per game than the Hawks allow (12.6). The Hawks are shooting 45.1% from the field, 3.2% higher than the 41.9% the Thunder's opponents have shot this season. TOP PERFORMERS: Hartenstein is shooting 54.3% and averaging 8.6 points for the Thunder. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is averaging 32.4 points over the last 10 games. Dyson Daniels is scoring 9.5 points per game and averaging 7.4 rebounds for the Hawks. Nickeil Alexander-Walker is averaging 3.7 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Thunder: 5-5, averaging 112.5 points, 45.9 rebounds, 22.5 assists, 8.0 steals and 4.1 blocks per game while shooting 46.4% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 109.6 points per game. Hawks: 6-4, averaging 116.5 points, 46.1 rebounds, 30.6 assists, 10.1 steals and 4.1 blocks per game while shooting 44.5% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 117.8 points. INJURIES: Thunder: Cason Wallace: out (shoulder), Thomas Sorber: day to day (knee), Chet Holmgren: out (knee), Jaylin Williams: day to day (back), Jalen Williams: out (ankle). Hawks: Henri Veesaar: out for season (acl), Jock Landale: day to day (hip), Mouhamed Gueye: out (foot), Asa Newell: out (toe), Keshon Gilbert: out (knee), Kingston Flemings: day to day (back). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
